# Celestial Pilgrimage
## Scripture
## "For here we do not have an enduring city, but we are looking for the city that is to come." - Hebrews 13:14
## Reflection
As we walk under the starry night sky, we're reminded that our journey on earth is not our final destination. Just as astronauts embark on a pilgrimage to explore the vastness of space, we're on a celestial pilgrimage, navigating the twists and turns of faith. The Milky Way, a majestic spiral galaxy, serves as a reminder of our place in God's vast plan. We're not just tiny specks in an infinite universe; we're beloved children of God, created with a purpose. As we gaze up at the stars, we're encouraged to look beyond our temporary dwelling and fix our eyes on the city that is to come – the heavenly city, where God dwells.
## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, thank you for the celestial reminder of our pilgrimage on earth. Help us to keep our eyes fixed on the city that is to come, where you dwell in all your glory. May our hearts be filled with longing for our eternal home, and may we live each day with purpose, knowing that our journey is not in vain. Guide us as we navigate the twists and turns of faith, and may we trust in your sovereignty over all creation. In Jesus' name, we pray, amen.
